rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Are these the Mag Mell Ruins?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Haven't you been here before?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Defence Force often uses it for training.[XENO:n ]
But I come here to do research.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
It's not really a place that people go.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Not surprising. There are monsters around[XENO:n ]
here that use Machine Soldier parts as armour.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Was this built by the Machine God Soldiers?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

There's a path for people to get in.[XENO:n ]
It might have been a vehicle of some kind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Like the Defence Force hover transports?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

A vehicle?[XENO:n ]
But it's so big...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]It's amazing technology.[XENO:n ]
I wonder what kind of people made it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I ain't got a clue.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Let's keep moving.[XENO:n ]
